reason: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year, so paying ₹21,990 plus extra per-seat charges for our 6 to 20 staff is far too steep for my firm. While saving two hours every Saturday on GST reconciliations would be great, I refuse to buy into a pricing model that nickels-and-dimes us for extra seats.
objection: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive, especially with per-seat fees once we exceed 12 users?
would_change_my_mind: A flat annual price under ₹12,000 that covers all 20 of our staff with no per-user fees, combined with clear proof that it eliminates my weekend GST tracking.
